note: Iowa DNR state park in the Loess Hills near Hamburg, known for its vistas over the Missouri River valley; on the Lewis and Clark Historic Trail. The modern campground runs along a wooded valley road; a separate, more primitive equestrian campground sits to the north-east. Trails for hiking, mountain biking and horses; 7-acre Lake Virginia (electric motors only); eight cabins. --Claude
